def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    div_row=next((i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg),None)
    div_col=next((j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][j]!=bg),None)
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    def paint(cells,obj):
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=obj
    if div_row is not None:
        dc=grid[div_row][0]
        for j in range(w): out[div_row][j]=dc
        obj=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (bg,dc))
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==obj]
        mn=min(i for i,j in cells); mx=max(i for i,j in cells)
        if mn>div_row:
            s=mn-(div_row+1); paint([(i-s,j) for i,j in cells],obj)
            for j in range(w): out[mx-s+1][j]=8
        else:
            s=div_row-1-mx; paint([(i+s,j) for i,j in cells],obj)
            for j in range(w): out[mn+s-1][j]=8
    else:
        dc=grid[0][div_col]
        for i in range(h): out[i][div_col]=dc
        obj=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (bg,dc))
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==obj]
        mn=min(j for i,j in cells); mx=max(j for i,j in cells)
        if mn>div_col:
            s=mn-(div_col+1); paint([(i,j-s) for i,j in cells],obj)
            for i in range(h): out[i][mx-s+1]=8
        else:
            s=div_col-1-mx; paint([(i,j+s) for i,j in cells],obj)
            for i in range(h): out[i][mn+s-1]=8
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(k, transform(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
